refs.excerpt:
The GenLayer contract implements locked weighted criteria, independently compared criterion scores, exact integer weighted totals, evidence citations, a common appeal window, one targeted score appeal, preserved original scorecards, and settlement after appeals close.
Frozen evidence comes from wallet-bound GitHub files. Citation excerpts are derived from recorded line ranges; location checking does not establish the truth of a claim or correctness of an AI judgment.

The updated app has a weighted rubric editor, per-criterion original and latest scores, expandable evidence excerpts, immutable record digests, and a criterion selector for eligible appeals. The v3 UI is being published as part of this release; the existing public site may still show the accepted v2.3 build during acceptance testing.
Reviewer journey after publication: open the app, select Transparent Scorecards — Milestone 1, and inspect the submission docket. Choose View scorecard, compare original and latest criterion scores and totals, then expand an evidence citation and inspect immutable records. Choose Frozen evidence to see the saved evidence text.
